alive.last_commit_message:
fix(cli): remove local import os that shadowed module import in main() (#283)

* fix(cli): remove local import os that shadowed module import in main()

Every global env-setting flag (--api-key, --endpoint-url, --llm-api-key,
--llm-timeout, --stdio-timeout) crashed with UnboundLocalError because the
local import os inside the vulnerable-package branch of main() made os
function-local for the whole of main(), so the os.environ writes earlier in
main() hit an unbound local. The module-level import os already covers the
os.path use in that branch, so the local import is redundant.

Fixes #251

* fix(tests): setenv before delenv to avoid env-var leak in api-key repro test

Per maintainer review: monkeypatch.delenv(raising=False) records nothing
when the variable is absent, so main()'s direct os.environ set of
MCP_SCANNER_API_KEY leaked 'test-key-251' into later tests. Setting the
variable first makes monkeypatch record and restore the prior state.
